# Cruise Cruise no Mi

<div class="mod-page-icon" markdown="1">

![](../../assets/mods/inocruise.png)

</div>

Fourteen trades, talent trees, shipbuilding, settlements, events and trade routes.

Installed build `0.8.0`. [Browse all mods](index.md).

## Abilities

| In-game name | ID | In-game description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Acid Flask | `inocruise:acid_flask` | With your Experiment Equipment in your bag throw a flask of acid. It bursts where it lands. Every enemy within 3 blocks is burnt and poisoned for 4 seconds. A player or a boss half as long |
| Axe Throw | `inocruise:axe_throw` | With an axe in hand throw it straight ahead. You keep your axe |
| Big Catch | `inocruise:big_catch` | With a fishing rod in hand swing the enemy you look at up on your line and slam them down. Enemies around them are hit too |
| Blast Rock | `inocruise:blast_rock` | With a pickaxe in hand throw an Explosive Rock. It bursts where it lands and hurts every enemy within 3 blocks. It breaks no block |
| Bribe | `inocruise:bribe` | Pay off the enemy you look at within 8 blocks. For 10 seconds it stops fighting you and will not pick you again. Not a player or a boss |
| Coin Toss | `inocruise:coin_toss` | Throw a fistful of coins at the enemy you look at within 14 blocks. They cost you nothing |
| Crew Meal | `inocruise:crew_meal` | Hand a quick meal round. You and your crewmates and your animals within 6 blocks get 8 health back |
| Dissonance | `inocruise:dissonance` | Play a chord that grates. Every enemy within 5 blocks is hurt and weakened for 5 seconds. A player or a boss half as long |
| Field Dressing | `inocruise:field_dressing` | With your Experiment Equipment in your bag dress your wounds. You get 10 health back and are cured of poison and wither |
| Flambe | `inocruise:flambe` | Throw a jet of flame before you. Every enemy in front of you within 4 blocks is burnt and set alight for 3 seconds |
| Golden Bulwark | `inocruise:golden_bulwark` | A shield of gold of 8 health for 20 seconds for you and your crew within 8 blocks |
| Ground Breaker | `inocruise:ground_breaker` | With a pickaxe in hand strike the ground. A shock wave runs 8 blocks straight ahead. Every enemy on its way is hit and thrown up |
| Gust | `inocruise:gust` | Blow a gust before you. Every enemy in front of you within 8 blocks is hit and blown far back |
| Hammer Blow | `inocruise:hammer_blow` | With a forged weapon in hand strike the enemy you look at with all your weight. It hurts them a lot and throws them back |
| Harpoon Throw | `inocruise:harpoon_throw` | Throw a heavy harpoon straight ahead. It hits half as hard again an enemy who is in water |
| Hay Maker | `inocruise:hay_maker` | With a hoe in hand strike the enemy you look at from below. It hurts them a lot and throws them up in the air |
| Hook Shot | `inocruise:hook_shot` | With a fishing rod in hand cast the hook at the enemy you look at. It hurts them and pulls them to you. One too big to be pulled pulls you to them |
| Hornet Swarm | `inocruise:hornet_swarm` | Send a swarm of hornets at the enemy you look at. It stings them for 6 seconds and poisons the enemies by them |

| Jet Dash | `inocruise:jet_dash` | Fire your boots. You are thrown some 8 blocks where you look |
| Line Snare | `inocruise:line_snare` | With a fishing rod in hand bind the enemy you look at with your line. They can not move for 3 seconds. A player or a boss is held half as long |
| Magnet Pull | `inocruise:magnet_pull` | Switch your magnet on. Every enemy within 6 blocks is pulled to you and slowed for 2 seconds |
| Mallet Swing | `inocruise:mallet_swing` | Swing wide before you. Every enemy in front of you within 4 blocks is hit and thrown back |
| Mirage | `inocruise:mirage` | Vanish for 5 seconds. The creatures around you lose you and cannot find you again while you are hidden |
| Nail Shot | `inocruise:nail_shot` | Throw a fistful of nails straight ahead. The enemy they hit is hurt and slowed for 3 seconds. A player or a boss half as long |
| Needle Rain | `inocruise:needle_rain` | Throw a fan of needles before you. Every enemy in front of you within 6 blocks is hit |
